denominators.ci_representation: Reported-effect rows; fires if any parsed CI is one-sided or repeated.
denominators.uncertainty_state: Reported-effect rows; fires when uncertainty_state returns an unresolved state.
denominators.se_permitted: Reported-effect rows with at least one parsed CI; fires if any parsed CI is refused an SE (not permission granted).
denominators.zero_cell_state: Count-only rows with ai; fires on DOUBLE_ZERO or SINGLE_ZERO_CELL. Incomplete cells remain in N as unevaluable.
denominators.DoubleZero: Rows taking a binary-count or event/person-time Study.yi_vi path; fires only on the DoubleZero exception. Other refusals remain in N as unevaluable.
denominators.polarity_check: Reported-effect rows on death/mortality/survival outcomes; fires on EVENT_POLARITY_MISMATCH or NORMALISED.
denominators.multi_arm_groups: All served trial rows, grouped within each outcome; fires for each row belonging to a shared-control group (not per group).
denominators.apply_multi_arm_rule: All served trial rows, grouped within each outcome; fires for each row held for undeclared shared control; declared resolutions are separately typed.
denominators.count_only_under_hr: All rows on outcomes whose declared estimand names HR; fires on count-only input without an established HR.
denominators.hr_route: All reported HR rows, using the full served outcome pool and declared estimand; fires when a routing record is returned.
denominators.reconstruct_from_counts: Reported effects with RR/OR target and a different non-HR, nonempty scale (pipeline reconstruction guard); fires on RECONSTRUCTED.
denominators.transform_provenance: All reported-effect rows; fires on an exactly reproduced source-to-served transform.
denominators.conflict_check: Rows with a published point, both CI ends, and complete own/alternative counts; includes NOT_COMPARABLE, never silently drops them. Fires on SOURCE_EFFECT_CONFLICT.
denominators.published_model: All served trial rows (pipeline calls unconditionally); fires if a model is documented rather than NOT_STATED_IN_HELD_TEXT.
denominators.rate_ratio_labelled_as_rr: All served trial rows; fires when served RR quotes a matching effect typed RATE_RATIO or IRR by extract. Unlocated or ambiguous source effects remain in N as UNEVALUABLE.
